qasam hai fajar kay waqt ki ,
aur das raaton ki ,
aur juft ki aur taaq ki ,
aur raat ki jab woh chal kharri ho   ( kay aakhirat mein jaza o saza zaroor hogi )
aik aqal walay ( ko yaqeen dilaney ) kay liye yeh qasmen kafi hain kay nahi-?
kiya tum ney dekha nahi kay tumharay perwerdigar ney aad kay sath kiya sulook kiya
uss oonchay sutonon wali qoam irum kay sath
jiss kay barabar duniya kay mulkon mein koi aur qoam peda nahi ki gaee ?
aur samood ki uss qoam kay sath kiya kiya jiss ney wadi mein pathar ki chatano ko tarash rakha tha-?
aur meekhon walay firon kay sath kiya kiya-?
yeh woh log thay jinhon ney duniya kay mulkon mein sarkashi ikhtiyar kerli thi ,
aur unn mein boht fasad machaya tha ,
chunacheh tumharay perwerdigar ney unn per azab ka korra barsa diya .
yaqeen rakho tumhara perwerdigar sabb ko nazar mein rakhay huye hai .
lekin insan ka haal yeh hai kay jab uss ka perwerdigar ussay aazmata hai , aur inaam o ikram say nawazta hai to woh kehta hai kay :  meray perwerdigar ney meri izzat ki hai .
aur doosri taraf jab ussay aazmata hai , aur uss kay rizq mein tangi ker deta hai to kehta hai kay :  meray perwerdigar ney meri toheen ki hai .
hergiz aisa nahi chahiye .   sirf yehi nahi balkay tum yateem ki izzat nahi kertay ,
aur miskeeno ko khana khilaney ki aik doosray ko targheeb nahi detay ,
aur meeras ka maal samett samett ker kha jatay ho ,
aur maal say bey hadd mohabbat kertay ho .
hergiz aisa nahi chahiye . jab zameen ko koot koot ker reza reza kerdiya jaye ga ,
aur tumhara perwerdigar aur qataren baandhay huye farishtay ( meydan-e-hashar mein ) ayen gay ,
aur uss din jahannum ko samney laya jaye ga , to uss din insan ko samajh aaye gi , aur uss waqt samajh aaney ka moaqa kahan hoga-?
woh kahey ga kay :  kaash ! mein ney apni iss zindagi kay liye kuch aagay bhej diya hota !
phir uss din Allah kay barabar koi azab denay wala nahi hoga ,
aur naa uss kay jakarney ki tarah koi jakarney wala hoga .
. ( albatta naik logon  say kaha jaye ga kay : )  aey woh jaan jo ( Allah ki itaat mein ) chain paachuki hai !
apney perwerdigar ki taraf iss tarah loat ker aaja kay tu uss say razi ho , aur woh tujh say razi ,
aur shamil hoja meray ( naik ) bandon mein ,
aur dakhil hoja meri jannat mein .
